name: Outside The Box
source: Milo comes home to quite the scene- his roommate getting it on with a random stranger! Just the thing to get Milo quite... ahem- "worked up." It's been a while since he's gotten any- but lucky for him, it seems like the opportunity for him to have some fun of his own might be just around the corner.
translation: 米洛回到家，撞见了相当劲爆的一幕——他的室友正和一个素不相识的陌生人干得热火朝天！这画面实在让米洛有些……咳咳，“欲火中烧”。他自己也已经好一阵子没开过荤了——不过算他走运，属于他自己的寻欢良机似乎就在眼前。
